thread:
Devon: FYI — enterprise beta wants a 99.9% p95 latency SLA for Dedicated in eu-west-1 by EOW. They want formal launch criteria and a procurement plan. :eyes:
Maya: timeline sounds tight. Is the ask strictly latency or also throughput/ingress isolation?
Devon: both. They mentioned burstable traffic during EOD batch windows. Need a recommendation: accelerate region turn-up vs carve dedicated from current pools.
Samir: Options: 1) carve a small reserved pool (H100x2 nodes) and limit tenant set, 2) enable reserveless burst with spot fallback + autoscaler, 3) move them to a nearby region with capacity and do cross-region routing. Each has tradeoffs.
Olivia: Budget note — reserved pool will need a 3mo commit to make unit economics work. Finance can stretch to 1 quarter for strategic customers but needs explicit acceptance from sales.
Ben: From SRE side I'd prefer a phased rollout. Start with read-only non-prod traffic, then canary prod traffic to 10% of requests, watch p95 and OOMs. We can run synthetic tails.
Maya: Can we meet SLA without additional hardware by tuning batching/cache? What numbers do we need? Samir, can you run a quick sizing?
Samir: rough calc based on current model profile: p95 ~130ms on h100-80k-seq for our serving config. For 99.9% we need ~+30% headroom. If baseline concurrent QPS is 120, buffer to 160 ~= 4 nodes of H100-type for dedicated. I can produce a small spreadsheet.
Devon: good. Also need launch criteria spelled out: 1) synthetic p95 <= SLA for 48h, 2) successful canary at 10% for 24h without fallbacks, 3) cost per 1k requests within agreed band, 4) documented rollback runway.
Maya: add security/audit checklist for Private tenants — will impact lead time. Olivia will that affect procurement timing?
Olivia: yes, KMS onboarding usually adds 2 weeks. If we want SLA by EOW we need to accept a narrower scope (no KMS) or promise a behind-the-scenes KMS onboarding plan.
Samir: I'll draft two proposals: (A) Minimal: reserve 4 nodes in eu-west-1, limited tenancy, no KMS day-1; (B) Full: reserve 6 nodes + prioritized KMS+audit, later migration.
Ben: Operational playbook: include automated fallback to the hosted model variant and a traffic-shedding threshold. Example snippet for the autoscaler check we can add to the runbook:
```
# pseudo
if cpu_util > 75% and p95_latency > target:
  scale_up(1)
elif p95_latency < target and cpu_util < 40%:
  scale_down(1)
```
Samir: noted. I'll also simulate eviction tolerance for spot fallback.
Devon: action items: Samir — sizing + two proposal docs by tomorrow 10am. Maya — confirm customer is okay with limited-tenancy carve for week 1. Olivia — outline budget approval path. Ben — prepare canary test harness.
deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-runner job queued for 1719080000 (simulated test window).
Maya: thanks. If proposals look reasonable we'll lock in a PO and start node onboarding. :shipit:
Devon: thumbs up. Keep updates in this thread.
